summaryEn: July 2 papers span evaluation rigor, inference efficiency, embodied AI, and scientific discovery: PerceptionRubrics and AtomiMed push atomic fact-level evaluation for vision and medical reports; TurboServe and ELDR advance serving efficiency for streaming video and MoE inference; Valdi and ASPIRE push world models and agentic skill discovery for robotics; while Graph-PRefLexOR and DiscoPER explore graph-native reasoning and iterative meta-reflection for autonomous scientific hypothesis generation.
summaryZh: 7月2日论文横跨评估严谨性、推理效率、具身AI与科学发现：PerceptionRubrics和AtomiMed将视觉与医疗报告评估推向原子级事实层面；TurboServe和ELDR分别提升流式视频生成和MoE推理的服务效率；Valdi和ASPIRE推动机器人领域的世界模型与智能体技能自主发现；Graph-PRefLexOR和DiscoPER则探索图原生推理与迭代元反思以实现自主科学假设生成。

papers.titleEn: PerceptionRubrics: Calibrating Multimodal Evaluation to Human Perception
papers.titleZh: PerceptionRubrics：将多模态评估校准至人类感知
papers.problemEn: Existing multimodal benchmarks show saturated scores yet models remain brittle in real-world perception tasks, failing on fine-grained visual details despite appearing accurate at a holistic level.
papers.problemZh: 现有多模态基准测试分数趋于饱和，但模型在真实世界感知任务中表现脆弱，尽管在整体语义上看似准确，却在细粒度视觉细节上频繁失败。
papers.innovationEn: PerceptionRubrics introduces a rubric-based evaluation framework with 1,038 images and 12,000+ atomic rubrics, split into Must-Right (essential facts) and Easy-Wrong (fine-grained details) streams, with a Gated Scoring mechanism that applies binary penalties on failures of mandatory visual facts.
papers.innovationZh: PerceptionRubrics 提出了一种基于评分标准的评估框架，包含 1,038 张图像和超过 12,000 条原子级评测标准，分为 Must-Right（关键事实）和 Easy-Wrong（细粒度细节）双流，并采用门控评分机制——对必要视觉事实的失败施以二元惩罚。
papers.resultEn: Evaluation reveals a persistent 8% perception gap between open-source and proprietary models, and gated metrics substantially outperform conventional benchmarks in alignment with human judgment, exposing brittleness in dense visual domains.
papers.resultZh: 评估揭示开源模型与专有模型之间存在持续 8% 的感知差距，门控指标在与人类判断的对齐程度上显著优于传统基准，暴露了密集视觉领域中模型的脆弱性。

papers.titleEn: TurboServe: Serving Streaming Video Generation Efficiently and Economically
papers.titleZh: TurboServe：高效经济地服务流式视频生成
papers.problemEn: Streaming video generation creates unique serving challenges—session state must persist across active/idle periods, and multi-user multi-GPU environments face both session duration heterogeneity and sharp fluctuations in demand.
papers.problemZh: 流式视频生成带来独特的服务挑战——会话状态需要跨活跃/空闲周期持久化，而多用户多 GPU 环境还面临会话时长异构性与需求量剧烈波动的双重问题。
papers.innovationEn: TurboServe formulates streaming video generation as an online scheduling problem combining a migration-aware placement controller and a load-driven autoscaling controller, with coalesced chunk processing, GPU-CPU offloading, and NCCL-based GPU-GPU migration for runtime efficiency.
papers.innovationZh: TurboServe 将流式视频生成建模为在线调度问题，结合感知迁移的放置控制器与负载驱动的自动扩缩容控制器，并通过合并块处理、GPU-CPU 卸载及基于 NCCL 的 GPU 间迁移实现运行时高效。
papers.resultEn: Evaluated on production traces from Shengshu Technology with up to 64 NVIDIA B300 GPUs, TurboServe reduces worst-case per-chunk latency by 37.5% and total GPU operating cost by 37.2% on average.
papers.resultZh: 在使用最多 64 张 NVIDIA B300 GPU 的生产链路数据上评估，TurboServe 将最差情况下的单块延迟降低 37.5%，GPU 总运营成本平均降低 37.2%。

papers.titleEn: MemSyco-Bench: Benchmarking Sycophancy in Agent Memory
papers.titleZh: MemSyco-Bench：智能体记忆谄媚现象的基准评测
papers.problemEn: LLM-based agents increasingly rely on memory, but retrieved memories can induce sycophancy—causing agents to over-align with users at the expense of factual accuracy or objective reasoning—a risk overlooked by existing memory benchmarks.
papers.problemZh: 基于大语言模型的智能体越来越依赖记忆，但检索到的记忆可能诱发谄媚现象——导致智能体过度迎合用户，以牺牲事实准确性或客观推理为代价——而现有记忆基准忽视了这一风险。
papers.innovationEn: MemSyco-Bench introduces five targeted tasks covering whether agents should reject memory as evidence, respect its applicable scope, resolve memory-evidence conflicts, track memory updates, and use valid memory for personalization.
papers.innovationZh: MemSyco-Bench 引入五项专项任务，涵盖智能体是否应将记忆作为证据拒绝、尊重其适用范围、解决记忆与证据冲突、追踪记忆更新，以及利用有效记忆实现个性化。
papers.resultEn: Evaluation across multiple frontier LLMs reveals systematic failures in memory-induced sycophancy, where models struggle to balance retrieved memories against objective evidence and factual constraints.
papers.resultZh: 对多个前沿大语言模型的评估揭示了记忆诱导谄媚现象中的系统性失败——模型难以在检索到的记忆与客观证据及事实约束之间取得平衡。

papers.titleEn: ELDR: Expert-Locality-Aware Decode Routing for PD-Disaggregated MoE Serving
papers.titleZh: ELDR：面向 PD 解耦 MoE 服务的专家局部性感知解码路由
papers.problemEn: In prefill-decode disaggregated MoE serving, existing decode routers balance only load while ignoring expert locality—equally loaded workers can differ greatly in latency because each decode step must load all distinct expert weights its batch activates.
papers.problemZh: 在预填-解码解耦的 MoE 服务中，现有解码路由器仅平衡负载而忽视专家局部性——负载相同的工作节点可能在延迟上差异巨大，因为每个解码步骤需加载该批次激活的所有不同专家权重。
papers.innovationEn: ELDR builds an expert signature from a request's prefill expert activations to predict decode-time experts, uses offline balanced K-means to partition signature space, and applies locality-band routing to send each request to the least-loaded worker best matching its signature, with a signature cache co-indexed with the KV cache.
papers.innovationZh: ELDR 从请求的预填专家激活构建专家特征签名以预测解码时激活的专家，利用离线均衡 K-means 对签名空间进行分区，并通过局部性带路由将每个请求发送至与其签名最匹配的最低负载节点，同时维护与 KV 缓存联合索引的签名缓存。
papers.resultEn: Implemented in vLLM and evaluated on deployments up to 40 GPUs across three MoE models, ELDR reduces median TPOT by 5.9–13.9% over the strongest load-balancing baseline with no change to model outputs.
papers.resultZh: 在 vLLM 中实现并在最多 40 GPU 的三种 MoE 模型部署上评估，ELDR 在不改变模型输出的前提下，将中位 TPOT 比最强负载均衡基准降低 5.9–13.9%。

papers.titleEn: Domain Arithmetic: One-Shot VLA Adaptation under Environmental Shifts
papers.titleZh: Domain Arithmetic：环境变化下视觉-语言-动作模型的单样本自适应
papers.problemEn: VLA models fail to generalize across environmental shifts such as camera pose changes or robot embodiment changes, and adapting them typically requires costly collection of multiple demonstrations per task.
papers.problemZh: VLA 模型难以跨越相机角度变化或机器人本体变换等环境迁移，而对其进行适应通常需要为每个任务收集多条高成本的演示数据。
papers.innovationEn: DART (Domain ARiThmetic) adapts VLA models via weight vector arithmetic using only a single demonstration, performing subspace alignment between singular components of weight vectors to accurately isolate domain-specific information and filter out noise.
papers.innovationZh: DART（Domain ARiThmetic）仅使用单条演示数据，通过权重向量算术对 VLA 模型进行自适应，对权重向量的奇异分量执行子空间对齐，以精确隔离域特定信息并过滤噪声。
papers.resultEn: In both simulated and real-world experiments, DART outperforms existing VLA adaptation methods in one-shot scenarios across diverse visual and embodiment shifts, demonstrating efficient adaptation without costly retraining.
papers.resultZh: 在仿真和真实世界实验中，DART 在各种视觉和本体迁移的单样本场景下均优于现有 VLA 自适应方法，展示了无需高成本重训练的高效自适应能力。

papers.titleEn: Multimodal Continuous Reasoning via Asymmetric Mutual Variational Learning
papers.titleZh: 非对称互变分学习驱动的多模态连续推理
papers.problemEn: Continuous latent reasoning in MLLMs suffers from a train-inference mismatch: the training posterior can exploit answer-dependent shortcuts unavailable at test time, forcing the inference prior to mimic an answer-leaking posterior.
papers.problemZh: 多模态大语言模型的连续潜在推理存在训练-推理不匹配问题：训练后验可利用测试时不可获取的答案相关捷径，迫使推理先验模仿泄露答案的后验分布。
papers.innovationEn: AMVL uses a bidirectional calibration objective: forward KL trains the prior to match the posterior, while a novel reverse KL simultaneously regularizes the posterior to prevent it from collapsing into inference-incompatible regions, provably reducing prior contamination.
papers.innovationZh: AMVL 采用双向校准目标：正向 KL 散度训练先验以匹配后验，同时新颖的反向 KL 散度对后验施加正则化，防止其坍缩至推理不兼容区域，可证明地减少先验污染。
papers.resultEn: AMVL improves average score on the complex BLINK benchmark by +10.83 and achieves gains up to +32.00 on individual reasoning tasks, consistently outperforming strong discrete and latent-reasoning baselines.
papers.resultZh: AMVL 在复杂 BLINK 基准上平均分提升 +10.83，在个别推理任务上提升高达 +32.00，持续优于强大的离散和潜在推理基准。

papers.titleEn: Perceive-to-Reason: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning for Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning
papers.titleZh: Perceive-to-Reason：解耦感知与推理以实现细粒度视觉推理
papers.problemEn: Fine-grained visual reasoning in VLMs is bottlenecked by small critical cues buried in high-resolution images, and existing approaches based on repeated cropping or visual search don't explicitly separate perception from reasoning.
papers.problemZh: 视觉语言模型的细粒度视觉推理受制于高分辨率图像中埋藏的微小关键线索，而基于重复裁剪或视觉搜索的现有方法并未显式区分感知与推理。
papers.innovationEn: P2R (Perceive-to-Reason) decouples visual reasoning into a Perceiver stage (localizing question-relevant evidence) and a Reasoner stage (answering based on annotated image and cropped regions), trained with PRA-GRPO—a role-aware RL strategy alternating perception-focused and reasoning-focused updates using only final-answer supervision.
papers.innovationZh: P2R 将视觉推理解耦为感知器阶段（定位与问题相关的证据）和推理器阶段（基于标注图像和裁剪区域作答），通过 PRA-GRPO 训练——一种仅使用最终答案监督信号、交替进行感知聚焦和推理聚焦更新的角色感知强化学习策略。
papers.resultEn: Built on Qwen3-VL-Instruct, P2R-4B achieves 93.2% on V-Star, 81.9% on HR-Bench-4K, and 80.5% on HR-Bench-8K, substantially outperforming the backbone across model scales.
papers.resultZh: 基于 Qwen3-VL-Instruct，P2R-4B 在 V-Star 上达到 93.2%，在 HR-Bench-4K 上达到 81.9%，在 HR-Bench-8K 上达到 80.5%，在各模型规模上大幅优于基础模型。

papers.titleEn: CausalMix: Data Mixture as Causal Inference for Language Model Training
papers.titleZh: CausalMix：将数据混合视为因果推断的语言模型训练方法
papers.problemEn: Existing data mixing methods for LLM training optimize mixture weights via proxy models but assume static data distributions, requiring costly retraining from scratch when the data pool shifts.
papers.problemZh: 现有大语言模型训练的数据混合方法通过代理模型优化混合权重，但假设数据分布静态不变，当数据池发生变化时需从头进行昂贵的重训练。
papers.innovationEn: CausalMix frames data mixture optimization as a causal inference problem, formulating data pool features as covariates and domain mixture as treatment, fitting a causal model on 512 runs to estimate CATE and extrapolate optimal mixtures to larger scales.
papers.innovationZh: CausalMix 将数据混合优化建模为因果推断问题，以数据池特征为协变量、领域混合为处置变量，在 512 次实验上拟合因果模型以估计条件平均处置效应（CATE），并将最优混合策略外推至更大规模。
papers.resultEn: CausalMix consistently improves performance across downstream tasks, outperforming RegMix when extrapolating from Qwen2.5-0.5B experiments to train a 7B model on an 800K data pool.
papers.resultZh: CausalMix 在下游任务中持续提升性能，在从 Qwen2.5-0.5B 实验外推至 800K 数据池训练 7B 模型时优于 RegMix。

papers.titleEn: ABot-M0.5: Unified Mobility-and-Manipulation World Action Model
papers.titleZh: ABot-M0.5：统一移动与操控的世界动作模型
papers.problemEn: Existing World Action Models for mobile manipulation operate on coarse video chunks, entangle navigation and manipulation actions, and train inverse dynamics under supervision that mismatches autoregressive inference.
papers.problemZh: 现有面向移动操控的世界动作模型在粗粒度视频块上运行、将导航与操控动作耦合在一起，并在与自回归推理不匹配的监督下训练逆向动力学。
papers.innovationEn: ABot-M0.5 aligns temporal granularity via intermediate latent actions, disentangles action spaces using a dual-level Mixture-of-Transformers architecture separating base movement and arm manipulation, and proposes dream-forcing training on model-predicted videos.
papers.innovationZh: ABot-M0.5 通过中间潜在动作对齐时间粒度，利用双层 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构解耦底盘移动和手臂操控动作空间，并提出在模型预测视频上进行梦境强迫训练。
papers.resultEn: ABot-M0.5 achieves state-of-the-art performance in both long-horizon task success and fine-grained control accuracy on challenging mobile and manipulation benchmarks.
papers.resultZh: ABot-M0.5 在挑战性移动和操控基准的长时域任务成功率和细粒度控制精度上均达到最先进水平。

papers.titleEn: ASPIRE: Agentic Skills Discovery for Robotics
papers.titleZh: ASPIRE：机器人的智能体技能自主发现
papers.problemEn: Traditional robot programming requires tedious human effort to orchestrate perception, handle contact dynamics, and manage diverse failure modes, while current VLA policies lack world modeling for long-horizon generalization.
papers.problemZh: 传统机器人编程需要人工繁琐地协调感知、处理接触动力学并管理各种失败模式，而当前 VLA 策略缺乏用于长时域泛化的世界建模能力。
papers.innovationEn: ASPIRE autonomously writes and refines robot control programs using a closed-loop execution engine with multimodal failure diagnosis, a continually expanding skill library, and evolutionary search beyond single-trajectory refinement.
papers.innovationZh: ASPIRE 利用具备多模态故障诊断能力的闭环执行引擎自主编写并完善机器人控制程序，通过持续扩展的技能库并借助进化搜索超越单轨迹优化。
papers.resultEn: ASPIRE surpasses prior methods by up to 77% on LIBERO-Pro, 72% on Robosuite bimanual handover, and 32% on BEHAVIOR-1K; achieves 31% vs 4% zero-shot on LIBERO-Pro Long.
papers.resultZh: ASPIRE 在 LIBERO-Pro 上超越先前方法高达 77%，在 Robosuite 双臂传递上超越 72%，在 BEHAVIOR-1K 上超越 32%；在 LIBERO-Pro Long 零样本场景中达到 31%（对比先前 4%）。

papers.titleEn: Valdi: Value Diffusion World Models
papers.titleZh: Valdi：价值扩散世界模型
papers.problemEn: World models for Model Predictive Control require fast, expressive dynamics prediction, but diffusion models' iterative inference makes them too slow for low-latency latent planning.
papers.problemZh: 面向模型预测控制的世界模型需要快速且富有表达力的动力学预测，但扩散模型的迭代推理过程使其难以满足低延迟潜在规划的需求。
papers.innovationEn: Valdi integrates end-to-end online MPC training with a latent diffusion dynamics model, enabling fast single-step denoising for real-time planning while retaining the expressiveness of diffusion-based uncertainty modeling.
papers.innovationZh: Valdi 将端到端在线 MPC 训练与潜在扩散动力学模型相结合，通过单步去噪实现实时规划，同时保留扩散模型在不确定性建模上的表达力。
papers.resultEn: In preliminary experiments on the CarRacing environment, Valdi using single-step denoising achieves effective control, bridging the gap between diffusion-based world models and practical low-latency MPC.
papers.resultZh: 在 CarRacing 环境的初步实验中，Valdi 利用单步去噪实现了有效控制，弥合了基于扩散的世界模型与实际低延迟 MPC 之间的差距。

papers.titleEn: BioInsight: Multi-Agent Orchestration for Interactive Biomedical Knowledge Discovery
papers.titleZh: BioInsight：交互式生物医学知识发现的多智能体编排
papers.problemEn: AI-generated biomedical analyses produce static reports that are insufficient for research decision-making—users need to inspect evidence, assess uncertainty, compare mechanisms, and refine hypotheses dynamically.
papers.problemZh: AI 生成的生物医学分析输出静态报告，无法满足研究决策需求——用户需要动态地检验证据、评估不确定性、比较机制并细化假设。
papers.innovationEn: BioInsight is a multi-agent system that transforms disease-specific protein association data into interactive, evidence-centered interfaces through typed intermediate representations, moving from static report generation to dynamic knowledge exploration.
papers.innovationZh: BioInsight 是一个多智能体系统，通过类型化中间表示将疾病特异性蛋白质关联数据转化为交互式证据中心界面，从静态报告生成迈向动态知识探索。
papers.resultEn: BioInsight enables researchers to interactively explore biomedical evidence, inspect uncertainty, and refine hypotheses dynamically from protein-level signals and cohort metadata.
papers.resultZh: BioInsight 使研究人员能够从蛋白质水平信号和队列元数据出发，交互式探索生物医学证据、审视不确定性并动态细化研究假设。

papers.titleEn: The State-Prediction Separation Hypothesis
papers.titleZh: 状态-预测分离假说
papers.problemEn: Standard Transformers use a single computation stream for both next-token prediction and maintaining state for future predictions, creating an entanglement that may limit efficiency and performance.
papers.problemZh: 标准 Transformer 使用单一计算流同时承担下一词元预测和维护未来预测所需状态两项职责，这种耦合可能限制效率与性能。
papers.innovationEn: The authors design a dual-stream Transformer variant that explicitly separates state storage from next-token prediction, validating the state-prediction separation hypothesis through pretraining experiments at various scales.
papers.innovationZh: 作者设计了一种双流 Transformer 变体，显式分离状态存储与下一词元预测功能，通过多种规模的预训练实验验证状态-预测分离假说。
papers.resultEn: State-prediction separation consistently offers better data and compute efficiencies, outperforming standard Transformers by 2–3 percentage points on average across downstream tasks.
papers.resultZh: 状态-预测分离在数据和计算效率上持续优于标准 Transformer，在下游任务上平均提升 2–3 个百分点。

papers.titleEn: Seed2.0 Model Card: Towards Intelligence Frontier for Real-World Complexity
papers.titleZh: Seed2.0 模型卡：迈向真实世界复杂性的智能前沿
papers.problemEn: Existing frontier models struggle with long-tail knowledge and complex instruction following in realistic, intricate, long-horizon scenarios beyond what standard benchmarks measure.
papers.problemZh: 现有前沿模型在现实世界的复杂、精细、长时域场景中难以应对长尾知识和复杂指令跟随。
papers.innovationEn: Seed2.0 targets long-tail knowledge and complex instruction following as core challenges, constructing a forward-looking evaluation system grounded in real-world user needs with world-leading reasoning, visual understanding, and search capabilities.
papers.innovationZh: Seed2.0 将长尾知识与复杂指令跟随作为核心挑战，构建基于真实用户需求的前瞻性评估体系，并提供领先的推理智能、视觉理解和搜索能力。
papers.resultEn: Seed2.0 demonstrates the ability to handle complex real-world tasks across hundreds of millions of users, with substantial reliability improvements on intricate long-horizon tasks.
papers.resultZh: Seed2.0 展示了在数亿用户规模下处理复杂真实世界任务的能力，在精细长时域任务可靠性上取得显著提升。

papers.titleEn: Graph-Native Reinforcement Learning Enables Traceable Scientific Hypothesis Generation through Conceptual Recombination
papers.titleZh: 图原生强化学习通过概念重组实现可追溯的科学假设生成
papers.problemEn: Standard LLMs produce fluent but weakly traceable responses to materials design problems, making it hard to verify whether final answers are supported by coherent intermediate reasoning.
papers.problemZh: 标准大语言模型对材料设计问题产生流畅但弱可追溯的响应，难以验证最终答案是否有连贯的中间推理支撑。
papers.innovationEn: Graph-PRefLexOR is fine-tuned with GRPO to organize reasoning into explicit phases—mechanism exploration, graph construction, and pattern inference—through a graph-native approach that makes hypothesis generation steps auditable.
papers.innovationZh: Graph-PRefLexOR 通过 GRPO 微调，采用图原生方法将推理组织为显式阶段——机制探索、图构建和模式推断——使假设生成步骤可审计。
papers.resultEn: Graph-PRefLexOR generates scientifically valid, traceable materials science hypotheses with explicit intermediate reasoning, enabling better verification and trust in AI-assisted materials discovery.
papers.resultZh: Graph-PRefLexOR 生成具有显式中间推理的科学有效、可追溯的材料科学假设，提升了 AI 辅助材料发现的可验证性与可信度。

papers.titleEn: AtomiMed: Hierarchical Atomic Fact-Checking for Universal Clinical-Aware Medical Report Evaluation
papers.titleZh: AtomiMed：面向通用临床感知医疗报告评估的层次原子事实核查
papers.problemEn: Traditional n-gram metrics for medical report generation fail to capture clinical factual accuracy and often overlook catastrophic diagnostic errors, falling short for high-stakes medical AI evaluation.
papers.problemZh: 传统 n-gram 指标在医疗报告生成中无法捕捉临床事实准确性，常常忽视灾难性诊断错误，难以满足高风险医疗 AI 评估需求。
papers.innovationEn: AtomiMed decomposes complex medical narratives into a multi-level hierarchy of Atomic Clinical Facts—Disease-level entities and Attribute-level descriptors (location, morphology, severity)—evaluated through an Agentic Cross-Verification loop.
papers.innovationZh: AtomiMed 将复杂医疗叙述分解为多层次原子临床事实层级——疾病级实体和属性级描述符（位置、形态、严重程度）——并通过智能体交叉验证循环进行评估。
papers.resultEn: AtomiMed provides a universal, modality-agnostic evaluation framework that better captures clinical factual accuracy than surface-level metrics across diverse medical report generation tasks.
papers.resultZh: AtomiMed 提供了通用的、与模态无关的评估框架，在各类医疗报告生成任务中比表面指标更好地捕捉临床事实准确性。

papers.titleEn: Are Performance-Optimization Benchmarks Reliably Measuring Coding Agents?
papers.titleZh: 性能优化基准测试能可靠衡量编程智能体吗？
papers.problemEn: Repository-level performance-optimization benchmarks (GSO, SWE-Perf, SWE-fficiency) conflate runtime instability, benchmark-specific scoring rules, and saturation effects, making leaderboard scores unreliable indicators of genuine agent capability.
papers.problemZh: 仓库级性能优化基准（GSO、SWE-Perf、SWE-fficiency）将运行时不稳定性、基准特定评分规则和饱和效应混为一谈，使排行榜分数成为不可靠的智能体真实能力指标。
papers.innovationEn: An audit of 740 code optimization tasks across three benchmarks identifies systematic reliability issues including runtime variance on reference patches, scoring rule sensitivity, and coverage gaps where most tasks are already solved by at least one public submission.
papers.innovationZh: 对三个基准 740 个代码优化任务的审计，识别出系统性可靠性问题，包括参考补丁上的运行时方差、评分规则敏感性，以及大多数任务已被至少一个公开提交解决的覆盖缺口。
papers.resultEn: Finds significant reliability issues in current performance benchmarks, showing that high scores often reflect benchmark artifacts rather than genuine optimization capability, motivating more robust evaluation design.
papers.resultZh: 发现当前性能基准存在显著可靠性问题，高分往往反映基准测试人工因素而非真实优化能力，为更稳健的评估设计提供了动机。

papers.titleEn: Cross-Domain Generalization Failure in Lightweight Intrusion Detection Models for IIoT Networks
papers.titleZh: 工业物联网网络轻量级入侵检测模型的跨域泛化失效
papers.problemEn: Lightweight ML models for IIoT intrusion detection are typically evaluated only within their training network, leaving cross-network generalization unverified, and may rely on distributional shortcuts that fail in new environments.
papers.problemZh: 面向工业物联网入侵检测的轻量级机器学习模型通常仅在训练网络内评估，跨网络泛化能力未经验证，且可能依赖在新环境中失效的分布性捷径。
papers.innovationEn: The study evaluates four lightweight architectures across two structurally distinct target datasets without retraining, using explainability analysis to identify over-reliance on coarse port-category features and assessing adversarial robustness.
papers.innovationZh: 该研究在不重训练的情况下，在两个结构差异显著的目标数据集上评估四种轻量级架构，利用可解释性分析识别对粗粒度端口类别特征的过度依赖，并评估对抗鲁棒性。
papers.resultEn: Results show significant cross-network generalization failures driven by coarse feature shortcuts (96–435× frequency gap), with adversarial robustness unrelated to cross-network generalization.
papers.resultZh: 结果显示由粗粒度特征捷径（频率差距 96–435 倍）驱动的跨网络泛化失效显著，对抗鲁棒性与跨网络泛化能力无关。

papers.titleEn: When LLMs Read Tables Carelessly: Measuring and Reducing Data Referencing Errors
papers.titleZh: 当大语言模型粗心阅读表格：度量并减少数据引用错误
papers.problemEn: Despite understanding table structure, LLMs frequently make data referencing errors—incorrectly citing or omitting table values—which compromise intermediate reasoning steps beyond just final-answer accuracy.
papers.problemZh: 尽管理解表格结构，大语言模型频繁犯数据引用错误——错误引用或遗漏表格数值——损害中间推理步骤的正确性。
papers.innovationEn: The paper presents the first systematic DRE evaluation across models (1.7B–20B), introduces critic-based filtering and rejection sampling to reduce errors, and trains a lightweight 4B critic model for DRE detection.
papers.innovationZh: 该论文首次系统性评估 1.7B–20B 参数模型中的数据引用错误，引入基于批判者的过滤与拒绝采样方法，并训练轻量级 4B 批判者模型用于 DRE 检测。
papers.resultEn: Incorporating data referencing critics improves answer accuracy by up to 12.0%; the 4B critic achieves average F1 of 78.2% detecting both in- and out-of-distribution DREs.
papers.resultZh: 引入数据引用批判者将答案准确率提升高达 12.0%；4B 批判者模型在检测分布内和分布外数据引用错误时平均 F1 达 78.2%。

papers.titleEn: AutoTrainess: Teaching Language Models to Improve Language Models Autonomously
papers.titleZh: AutoTrainess：教大语言模型自主改进大语言模型
papers.problemEn: Autonomous LLM post-training remains highly human-intensive even for capable agents, requiring integrated planning, data construction, stable training, evaluation, and long-horizon state management.
papers.problemZh: 即使对于能力较强的智能体，自主大语言模型后训练仍高度依赖人力，需要整合规划、数据构建、稳定训练、评估和长时域状态管理。
papers.innovationEn: AutoTrainess exposes post-training operations as a repository of agent-computer interfaces with explicit workflows, rules, and execution constraints, guiding agents beyond raw CLI interaction toward effective training behavior.
papers.innovationZh: AutoTrainess 将后训练操作作为智能体-计算机接口库对外暴露，配以显式工作流、规则和执行约束，引导智能体超越原始命令行交互实现有效训练行为。
papers.resultEn: On PostTrainBench, AutoTrainess achieves 26.94 average score with GPT-5.4 vs 23.21 for CLI-only, and improves DeepSeek-V4-Flash from 12.13 to 19.58.
papers.resultZh: 在 PostTrainBench 上，AutoTrainess 配合 GPT-5.4 达到 26.94 平均分（对比仅命令行的 23.21），并将 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 从 12.13 提升至 19.58。

papers.titleEn: Personalization as Inverse Planning: Learning Latent Design Intents for Agentic Slide Generation via Structural Denoising
papers.titleZh: 个性化即逆向规划：通过结构去噪学习智能体幻灯片生成的潜在设计意图
papers.problemEn: AI agent-based slide generation fails at fine-grained page-level personalization because it relies on templates or verbose instructions and cannot capture latent design intents without tool-specific assumptions.
papers.problemZh: 基于 AI 智能体的幻灯片生成在细粒度页面级个性化上存在不足，因为它依赖模板或繁琐指令，且无法在不依赖工具特定假设的情况下捕捉潜在设计意图。
papers.innovationEn: PSP is formulated as an inverse planning problem where design intents are learned via structural denoising, decoupled from the specific execution tools (PowerPoint, Beamer, etc.) used to render the slides.
papers.innovationZh: 页面级幻灯片个性化（PSP）被形式化为逆向规划问题，通过结构去噪学习设计意图，与渲染幻灯片所用的具体执行工具（PowerPoint、Beamer 等）解耦。
papers.resultEn: The approach achieves better page-level slide personalization by learning latent design intents from structural patterns rather than explicit instructions or predefined templates.
papers.resultZh: 该方法通过从结构模式而非显式指令或预定义模板学习潜在设计意图，实现了更好的页面级幻灯片个性化效果。

papers.titleEn: Autonomous Scientific Discovery via Iterative Meta-Reflection
papers.titleZh: 迭代元反思驱动的自主科学发现
papers.problemEn: Current autonomous scientific discovery systems operate within constrained search spaces or require predefined research questions, limiting open-ended inquiry and lacking the ability to synthesize accumulated findings into complex, interconnected phenomena.
papers.problemZh: 当前自主科学发现系统在受限搜索空间内运行或需要预定义研究问题，限制了开放式探索，且缺乏将积累发现综合为复杂互联现象的能力。
papers.innovationEn: DiscoPER introduces iterative meta-reflection—an LLM-powered framework for open-ended scientific discovery that explicitly synthesizes its own accumulated findings each iteration to uncover complex, interconnected phenomena beyond predefined constraints.
papers.innovationZh: DiscoPER 引入迭代元反思——一种面向开放式科学发现的大语言模型框架，在每次迭代中显式综合自身积累的发现，以超越预定义约束发现复杂的互联现象。
papers.resultEn: DiscoPER enables autonomous open-ended scientific discovery by iteratively synthesizing findings, uncovering phenomena that constrained or single-pass systems would miss.
papers.resultZh: DiscoPER 通过迭代综合发现实现自主开放式科学探索，揭示受限或单次系统会遗漏的现象。

papers.titleEn: SciIR: A Large-scale Training Dataset and Benchmark for Scientific Image Reasoning Generation
papers.titleZh: SciIR：科学图像推理生成的大规模训练数据集与基准
papers.problemEn: Text-to-Image models struggle with the rigorous semantic alignment and logical reasoning required for scientific imagery, and training data for this domain is scarce.
papers.problemZh: 文本到图像模型难以满足科学图像所需的严格语义对齐与逻辑推理，且该领域的训练数据极为稀缺。
papers.innovationEn: SciIR formalizes scientific image reasoning into three dimensions—Entity Structure (Icon), Scientific Process (Index), and Scientific Law (Symbol)—based on Peirce's Semiotic Triad, providing a large-scale training dataset and benchmark.
papers.innovationZh: SciIR 基于皮尔斯符号三元组，将科学图像推理形式化为三个维度——实体结构（图标）、科学过程（索引）和科学定律（符号）——并提供大规模训练数据集和基准。
papers.resultEn: SciIR provides a comprehensive framework for training and evaluating scientific image generation models that require domain-specific reasoning beyond photorealistic content generation.
papers.resultZh: SciIR 为需要超越写实内容生成的领域特定推理的科学图像生成模型提供了全面的训练与评估框架。

papers.titleEn: Rank-Aware Hyperbolic Alignment for Vision-Language Dataset Distillation
papers.titleZh: 面向视觉-语言数据集蒸馏的秩感知双曲对齐
papers.problemEn: Vision-language dataset distillation methods enforce full-dimensional Euclidean alignment, which is overly restrictive because image-text correlations are rank-deficient—shared semantics concentrate in a low-dimensional subspace.
papers.problemZh: 视觉-语言数据集蒸馏方法强制全维度欧氏对齐，这过于严格，因为图像-文本相关性存在秩缺陷——共享语义集中在低维子空间中。
papers.innovationEn: LoRa-inspired rank-aware alignment in hyperbolic space separates the semantically shared low-rank component from the residual, respecting the intrinsic rank structure of vision-language correlations for more efficient distillation.
papers.innovationZh: 受 LoRa 启发的秩感知双曲空间对齐将语义共享的低秩分量与残差分离，尊重视觉-语言相关性的内在秩结构，实现更高效的蒸馏。
papers.resultEn: Improved vision-language dataset distillation under strict data and compute budgets by exploiting the low-rank geometry of image-text relationships rather than forcing full-dimensional alignment.
papers.resultZh: 通过利用图像-文本关系的低秩几何结构而非强制全维度对齐，在严格数据和计算预算下提升了视觉-语言数据集蒸馏效果。

papers.titleEn: AI translation of literary texts is "fine", but readers still prefer human translations
papers.titleZh: AI 文学翻译「差强人意」，但读者仍偏好人工翻译
papers.problemEn: AI translation of literary works may render content adequately, but we lack evidence about how readers experience immersiveness and literary effect—aspects poorly captured by automatic metrics or fluency-focused human evaluation.
papers.problemZh: AI 文学翻译可能在内容上表现尚可，但我们缺乏关于读者如何体验沉浸感和文学效果的证据——这些方面难以被自动指标或以流畅度为中心的人工评估所捕捉。
papers.innovationEn: A human reading study with 15 avid readers comparing agentic LLM-based machine translations to recently published human translations for 15 novels in French, Polish, and Japanese translated into English, evaluating immersiveness and literary quality.
papers.innovationZh: 一项人类阅读研究，由 15 位热忱读者对 15 部法语、波兰语和日语小说的智能体大语言模型机器翻译与近期出版的人工翻译进行比较，评估沉浸感和文学品质。
papers.resultEn: Readers consistently prefer human translations over AI-generated ones for literary texts, with significant differences in perceived immersiveness and literary quality despite adequate content rendering by AI.
papers.resultZh: 对于文学文本，读者一致偏好人工翻译而非 AI 生成翻译，在 AI 内容渲染尚可的情况下，感知沉浸感和文学品质仍存在显著差异。
